title: STARTDT activation followed by General Interrogation
purpose: Exercise IEC 60870-5-104 session activation and a subsequent station interrogation ASDU with a standard interrogation qualifier.
expected_behavior: The peer processes the STARTDT activation U-format and can then parse the following I-format C_IC_NA_1 request; the interrogation qualifier identifies station interrogation.
constraints_preserved: The U-format frame has length 0x04 for its four control bytes
The I-format length 0x0e equals four APCI control bytes plus the 10-byte ASDU
TypeID 100 is C_IC_NA_1 and qualifier 20 is used for station interrogation
All multibyte sequence, cause, common-address, and information-object fields use consistent fixed widths
issue_safety_notes: Valid structural analogue only; no historical issue payload, malformed length, or exploit behavior is asserted.
